raidSayLines.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Otis Bishop. Rail conductor. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Photo album, Wedding ring, Dispatcher's headset, Coat button, Home key. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. 📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Something moves out there — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A dog-shaped silence at the treeline. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ A DOG-SHAPED SILENCE AT THE TREELINE! You're on your own.
The dog-shaped silence at the treeline is on you — no warning, just teeth.
A dog-shaped silence at the treeline hits you for 16.
(dog-shaped silence at the treeline's hide absorbs 2.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free.
